properties.headline: Dust Advisory issued October 16 at 1:44PM MST until October 16 at 3:45PM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
The National Weather Service in Phoenix has issued a

* Dust Advisory for...
Pinal County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 345 PM MST.

* At 144 PM MST, a plume of dust was located 7 miles northwest of
Bapchule, or 7 miles southwest of Sun Lakes, and was stationary.

HAZARD...Less than one mile visibility with strong winds in excess
of 30 mph.

SOURCE...Satellite and traffic camera observations.

IMPACT...Hazardous travel.

* Locations impacted include...
Mainly rural areas of Pinal County.

This includes AZ Route 347 between mile markers 180 and 184.
properties.instruction:
Blowing dust brings reduced visibility, leading to dangerous driving
conditions. If driving, avoid blowing dust if possible. If caught in
dense blowing dust, pull off the road, turn off your lights and keep
your foot off the brake.

To report hazardous dust conditions, contact the National Weather
Service, or your nearest law enforcement agency, who will relay your
report to the National Weather Service office in Phoenix AZ.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 16 at 4:40PM EDT until October 16 at 5:45PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northwestern Collier County in southwestern Florida...

* WHEN...Until 545 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Ponding of water in urban or other areas is occurring or
is imminent.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 439 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to slow
moving thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to
begin shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 3 inches of
rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Naples, North Naples, Vineyards, Naples Park, Quail Creek Estate
and Pelican Bay.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

properties.description:

Counties. In Florida, Escambia Coastal, Santa Rosa Coastal and
Okaloosa Coastal Counties.

* WHEN...From Saturday evening through Tuesday morning.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.
properties.instruction:

float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

properties.instruction:

Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

fitting clothing. Try to limit strenuous activities to early morning
or evening. Take action when you see symptoms of heat exhaustion and
heat stroke.
